generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The Contractor should quote the item wise rates Excluding GST
All other terms and conditions as per NIT and KW2

technicalCriterionList.description: The bidders shall upload the work done certificate for having executed one any construction work of value not less than Rs. 9.30 lakhs and completed satisfactorily as a prime contractor within stipulated time period in the past 5 years (i.e., F/Y 2021-22 to 2025-26). Work done certificate shall be duly signed by the officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer or equivalent. (Note: Work done amount will be updated to the FY 2026-27 in which the tenders are invited. The value of the completed works will be given a weight of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the FY 2026-27 in which the tenders are invited)
The bidders shall upload a valid registered KPWD Civil contractor Licence of Class I/II/III

The banker certificate pertaining to Liquid Assets for availability of fund requirement for the work not less Rs.18.58 Lakhs issued by Nationalised / Scheduled Bank for the subject work addressed to General Manager (Civil), Corporate office, BESCOM after 31.10.2026 in the enclosed format

technicalCriterionList.description: Bidders who meet the above specified minimum qualifying criteria, will only be qualified, if their available tender capacity is more than the total tender value. N Number of years prescribed for completion of the works for which tenders are invited. B Value, at 2026-27 price level, of existing commitments and ongoing works to be completed during the next 12 Months
